spec.description: The unmodified spec passed into the setup process.

errors.description: Any errors that occurred during the setup process.

criticalFunctions.description:
Any functions that are considered critical to a setup process. For example,
{@link IdsDeploymentUtil#deployIdsControlTag} while running {@link IdsDeploymentUtil#setUpDevCluster}.

createControlTenantTag.description: Whether or not the {@link Tenant} and {@link Tag} for the IDS deployment exist.

deployIdsControlTag.description: Whether or not IDS was successfully deployed to the specified control tag.

createIdsControlVanityUrl.description: Whether or not a {@link VanityUrl} was successfully created for the IDS control tag.

registeredIdsControlVanityUrlDns.description:
Whether or not {@link IdsDeploymentUtil.createIdsControlVanityUrl} registered the DNS entry for
{@link IdsDevClusterSetupSpec.controlVanityUrl}.

setUpIdsDocumentationTag.description: Whether or not the documentation tag for the IDS control tag was successfully configured.

setUpIdsControlAclPrivileges.description: Whether or not the {@link EnableAclPrivilege}s for the IDS control tag were successfully set.

configureIdsControlPackageManager.description: Whether or not {@link PackageManager} was successfully configured.

registerDevelopmentPodInIdsControl.description: Whether or not the IDS control tag's development {@link Pod} was successfully registered in the control tag.

registerPlatformOrganizationInIdsControl.description: Whether or not the IDS control tag's {@link PlatformOrganization} was successfully registered in the control tag.

registerC3euser.description: Whether or not the 'c3euser' for the IDS control tag was successfully created.

configureAllEnvRemote.description: Whether or not {@link AllEnvRemote} was successfully configured.

configureC3AllEnvRemote.description: Whether or not {@link C3AllEnvRemote} was successfully configured.

setDevEnvironmentConfig.description: Whether or not {@link DevEnvironmentConfig} was successfully configured.

configureIdsDeploymentMode.description: Whether or not {@link MarketplaceConfig.readArtifactsEnabled} was set successfully.

configureIdsJenkins.description:
Whether or not the {@link FileSystem} mount for Jenkins and the {@link Jenkins} config for the specified
Jenkins instance were successfully configured.

configureDeploymentPipelines.description: Whether or not {@link DeploymentPipelineConfig} was successfully configured.

configureHttpTunnelConfig.description: Whether or not the {@link IdsSetupSpec.idsControlCanonicalUrl} was whitelisted for tunneled requests.

configureTwilioAccount.description: Whether or not a {@link Twilio} account was successfully configured.

title:
The result of an {@link IdsDeploymentUtil.setUpDevCluster} call. These flags indicate whether or not the matching function on
{@link IdsDeploymentUtil} succeeded or failed. The errors that occurred can be seen in {@link #errors}.
name: IdsDevClusterSetupResult
